notes.title: Engine Upgrade & Render Pipeline Upgrade
notes.content:
Sorry for the lack of updates recently but this is a big one! ːsteamhappyː
This update marks a major milestone for the game with a significant upgrade to Unity 6 and the integration of the Universal Render Pipeline (URP). These upgrades are a game-changer, providing improved performance, improved visuals, and a more polished overall experience. The patch also includes numerous gameplay improvements, bug fixes, and the beginning of a UI overhaul!
[b]Single Player[/b]
[list]
[*] Render Pipeline Upgrade to URP
[*] Unity 6 Engine Upgrade
[*] New weapon effects
[*] New Player UI Integration
[*] Optimized Bullet Instantiation
[*] Mission 6 Improvements
[*] Mission 7 Improvements
[*] God Rays Effects Fixed
[*] Texture File Size Optimization
[*] Mission 3 US Spawner Bug After Combat Fixed
[*] Fixed Zombie Death Effect Spawning in Wrong Location
[*] Fix Combat Music in Mission 7

[*] Fix Lighting in Missions 7 & 8
[*] Fixed Flashlight Toggle in Mission 7
[*] Added Puzzles Requiring Stims
[*] Lowered Volume in Mission 1 Outro Audio
[/list]

notes.title: Narrative Update, Fixes and New Multiplayer Maps
notes.content:
Hi all,

Thank you so much for you continued support. The game is really starting to shape up and I believe this is one of the strongest updates yet! The narrative storytelling overhaul has begun and the story will now be told in a more interesting way with 3D elements integrated with the 2D Comic panels. If you are interested in trying the single player with the improvements I would recommend resetting your save and starting over with all of the new fixes (there is a reset save button on the main menu). Please see below for the full list of fixes and updates: 
[b]SinglePlayer[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved story telling technique with a new flashback room
[*]Low Stamina effect added, screen sweat and breathing sound
[*]Pickup volume reduced e.g. weapon pick ups, health pick ups, death sound
[*]Headshots now have a hitmarker
[*]Stopped boxes being too wobbly when stacked 
[*]Sprinting while crouched will now uncrouch you
[*]Burning buildings now damage you when inside
[*]Exploding barrel no longer causes a framerate drop
[*]On death the game now respawns you at last checkpoint
[*]Fall damage has been disabled
[*]Weapons sway disabled while aiming down sights
[*]Mission 1 skybox seam no longer visible 
[*]Fixed Mission 2 gap in the cave collapse
[*]Gun firing after effect smoke burst bug fixed
[*]Trees leaves not being visible from underneath fixed
[*]Better skull model with animation for flying skull enemy (Thanks Rubber_Tech_Missouri)
[*]Updated Mission 1 with new gameplay and updated visuals / layout
[/list]
[b]MultiPlayer[/b]
[list]
[*]Multiplayer added Day-time Warehouse map 
[*]Multiplayer added Night-time Warehouse map 
[*]Multiplayer fixed multiple code errors
[*]Removed Guest player mode from multiplayer was causing crashes
[/list]
Again thank you all for the support!

notes.title: Progression Update + Patch
notes.content:
[b]Single Player Updates[/b]

Hello everyone! Sorry for the wait for this update it was a challenging one, you can now play the game with a much better sense of progression as I have made the levels unlock in order and have added a checkpoint system to the longer missions. I appreciate all your support and please share with me any bugs you find in the new systems (I'm sure there will be many haha!).  You can see a full list of the changes below:

[list]
[*] Level unlock system and mission checkpoints added
